text:
jana: Quick heads-up 1: running a docs health pass for the 3.2 release. Found a handful of small things that are fast to patch. Can people grab tiny PRs? :coffee:

jana: Summary from local scan (rg):```
$ rg --hidden -n "404|missing|frontmatter" docs | sed -n '1,200p'
docs/runtime/kv-cache.md:130:link -> /handbook/cache-compatibility (404)
docs/runbooks/deploy-checklist.md:8:frontmatter: missing 'weight' -> toc ordering break
docs/guides/prefix-caching.md:92:image -> /static/images/prefix-cache-v2.png (404)
docs/quickstarts/new-join.md:27:external gist -> gist.github.com/old-snippet (404)
docs/architecture/edge-routing.md:55:markdown link broken to /docs/old-edge (404)
```

leo: can take deploy-checklist frontmatter and edge-routing link.

maya: i'll pick kv-cache and the prefix-caching image. Will rehost the diagram under /assets/diagrams and compress >1MB.

nate: i'll do quickstarts/new-join gist replacement with an inline snippet and add a short note about provenance.

jana: thanks. tagging @sre-oncall since deploy-checklist touches runbook ordering. Can you confirm we don't have a dependent job that expects the old weight values?

sre-oncall: quick scan of infra-job configs--- looks safe. The job reads headers not weights. still, ping ops when merging.

jana: good catch. docs-bot: kick a pre-merge link scan once PRs are opened?

docs-bot: Roger. Will run link-scan on PR authors' forks and post results.

leo: PR 1301 opened for runbook frontmatter and edge link fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301  (small).

maya: PR 1302 opened for kv-cache move + compressed diagram: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1302

nate: PR 1303 for gist -> inline snippet + changelog note: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1303

jana: who can review 1301/1302/1303? trying to get these merged before the deploy cutoff at 14:00 PT.

olivia: i can review 1302 (images). add a short CHANGELOG bullet so release notes pick it up.

nate: happy to review 1301 now.

leo: docs-bot just posted scan results on 1301: one remaining external link to old docs page, updated to internal redirect.

leo: merged 1301. @nate can you run quick staging smoke?

nate: running a quick smoke now. will report back in ~10m.

docs-bot: [scan] PR 1302: image rehost complete, no broken links detected in changed files. https://ci.redwood-inference/scans/1769009999/pr/1302

maya: pushed a tiny alt-text improvement per accessibility note.

olivia: LGTM on 1302, merging.

nate: staging checked: TOC ordering fixed, kv-cache link resolves, image loads (webp fallback served). All three changes validated.

jana: excellent. final step: re-run full docs scan and add a single-line CHANGELOG entry in release notes for 3.2.0 mentioning the moved doc + image rehost.

docs-bot: [scan] Full docs pass: 0 new broken links found. Tagging release: docs/3.2.0-prep-clear.

jana: tagged release checklist as done and added notes to the release doc. Thanks folks! If anyone wants to double-check wording in the changelog, ping me.

leo: nice and tidy. low-risk wins :tada:

maya: thanks team, learning the rehost flow now.

sre-oncall: if deploy hits any issues ill post here and escalate. good to merge.

jana: great. closing this thread. If more dead links crop up during the deploy window, @jana will open followups.
